notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{B}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
